title: Read derived statistics instead of stored counters
outcome: Every surface that shows statistics reads a derived value, so nothing silently displays zeros once the counters stop being written.
acceptanceCriteria: The Redux initialize reducer calls deriveSetStats once per store update and keeps the result in state, matching how isSetInProgress is already handled.
No file under src/components/ imports deriveSetStats; components read the derived values from the store.
components/game/options/overview and components/game/stats/teams-stats show correct per-set and whole-match totals for a game whose stored counters were never written.
The frontend accumulation functions updateStats, discardOriginalStats and updateRotation are deleted rather than kept alongside the derivation.
